rust_summary: text in the world from `native_block_entity_submit` (`native_draw_text`), as a sign draws its lines.
doc_summary: `native_draw_text(draw, text, at, color, glowing, outline)` draws a `Text` under a block entity's pose as a sign draws its lines (`Font.drawInBatch`): one unit a font pixel, each span in its colour, glowing text full bright, an optional outline; it returns the width. Bundles need "hooks": @API:draw_text@.
